dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Just a few? I can trade more than that if you'd like.

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Haha, that's the spirit! Nothing beats a good ol' brawl between real fighters, am I right? Bielov, how about you start us off — go a few rounds with our guest, why don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Bielov
dialogues.text: You got it, Boss! I'll end this in three moves!

dialogues.speaker: Bielov
dialogues.text: S-Sorry, boss... I let everyone down...

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Hey, it's no big deal — we're just messing around. Bielov, go take a breather on the side.

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: You've got some slick moves, friend! The name's Terho — pleasure to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #I'm {NICKNAME}. Pleased to meet you, too!

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: I can tell you've seen your fair share of real combat. Guess we'll need to step it up. That last bout didn't count — let's go again! Incali, you're up!

dialogues.speaker: Incali
dialogues.text: Hmph, Boss, you only think of me when we're in trouble... Honestly. Well then, skilled one, shall we begin?

dialogues.speaker: Incali
dialogues.text: I—I lost...? To some random passerby?! Th—This can't be real!

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Hmph, so even Incali couldn't win... I've definitely been taking you too lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Bielov
dialogues.text: It's not your fault, Boss. Who'd have thought someone that strong would just happen to walk by...

dialogues.speaker: Incali
dialogues.text: Boss! We can't let them off the hook...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Oh-ho, so we're not just here to spar then?

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Don't get the wrong idea. Incali just means... We can't give up on winning so easily. After all, we're treasure hunters with a reputation to uphold.

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, I formally issue you a challenge. This time it's not just for fun — let's go all out and see what we're really made of!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Then I'll take all three of you at once.

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Alright then, we won't hold back!

dialogues.speaker: Incali
dialogues.text: Can't believe I lost to this passerby... three times!

dialogues.speaker: Bielov
dialogues.text: No, no, you and I lost twice each, and the boss only lost once, so it's not that bad...

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: #Heh! A loss is a loss, no point brooding over it. This {NICKNAME}'s really something else!

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: You two can't even beat me on a good day — and now you've seen a real master in action. See? You've got a lot of training to do.

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: As for me? Hah... Maybe it's time to consider early retirement. I wonder if Vaino's training ground is still hiring...

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're back! Bielov, you're up first! So, friend, ready to go a few rounds with us?

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: Hi, friend! Just gonna shoot targets all day? Doesn't that get a little dull? With skills like that, why not try trading a few blows with us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've got other things to do...

dialogues.speaker: Terho
dialogues.text: No worries. We're just hanging around killing time. Come back whenever you're free... or bored stiff!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm ready. Bring it on!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I've got other things to do...
